### help
Usage: ai-tasks [options] [command]

Local task state engine

Options:
  --json                                  Print one JSON response
  --include-terminal                      Include terminal tasks
  --all-projects                          Explicit aggregate read scope
  --project <slug>                        Explicit project scope
  --operation-id <uuid>                   Mutation operation ID
  --operation <uuid>                      Audit operation UUID filter
  --entity-id <uuid>                      Audit entity UUID filter
  --database-epoch <uuid>                 Current database epoch
  --expected-revision <integer>           Expected target revision
  --expected-config-revision <integer>    Expected project config revision
  --expected-settings-revision <integer>  Expected global settings revision
  --input <file>                          UTF-8 JSON input file, or - for stdin
  --limit <integer>                       Page size from 1 to 200
  --cursor <opaque>                       Continuation cursor
  --q <text>                              Literal text search
  --status <key>                          Status filter
  --state <state>                         Occurrence outcome state filter
  --category <key>                        Category filter
  --kind <kind>                           Task kind filter
  --emoji <emoji>                         Emoji filter
  --archive <mode>                        Archive mode: exclude, include, or only
  --deadline-preset <preset>              Deadline: overdue, today, from_tomorrow, next_3_days, undated
  --deadline-day <date>                   Exact local deadline day in application timezone: YYYY-MM-DD
  --day <date>                            Occurrence day under the project day rule: YYYY-MM-DD
  --from-day <date>                       First occurrence day of a window, inclusive: YYYY-MM-DD
  --to-day <date>                         Last occurrence day of a window, inclusive: YYYY-MM-DD
  -V, --version                           output the version number
  -h, --help                              display help for command

Commands:
  help                                    Show command help
  version                                 Show application version
  meta                                    Read global metadata without mutations
  serve                                   Start the API and web interface (loopback unless AI_TASKS_HOST is set)
  project                                 Manage projects
  task                                    Manage ordinary and recurring tasks
  config                                  Read, preview, and migrate project configuration
  description                             Preview saved-description Markdown
  dependency                              Manage explicitly scoped ordinary-task prerequisites
  audit                                   Read immutable history in an explicit scope
  worker
  recurrence                              Read and manage explicitly scoped recurring-task schedules
  occurrence                              Read and resolve occurrences belonging to an explicit recurring parent
  settings                                Read global settings or update them with explicit project attribution
  agenda                                  Read project-grouped local calendar buckets at one captured instant
  priorities                              Read priorities within each project and its configured model
  stats                                   Read separate task and occurrence counts; JSON from/to bounds are half-open
  backup                                  Manage verified snapshots and recovery jobs
### task --help
Usage: ai-tasks task [options] [command]

Manage ordinary and recurring tasks

Options:
  -h, --help            display help for command

Commands:
  board                 Read one project board column in shared manual order
  list                  List tasks in an explicit scope
  position <task-id>    Move a task to an explicitly guarded board position
  get <task-id>         Read a task and its saved description
  create                Create an ordinary or recurring task
  update <task-id>      update an ordinary or recurring task
  transition <task-id>  transition an ordinary or recurring task
  archive <task-id>     archive an ordinary or recurring task
  restore <task-id>     restore an ordinary or recurring task
### task create --help
Usage: ai-tasks task create [options]

Create an ordinary or recurring task

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
### occurrence complete --help
Usage: ai-tasks occurrence complete [options] <task-id>

complete selected occurrence revisions atomically

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
### backup status --help
Usage: ai-tasks backup status [options] [job-id]

Read external job status without opening SQLite

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
